{{Introduction
|introduction      = '''''SkiFree''''' is a {{Glossary:Singleplayer}} {{Glossary:Top-down view}} {{Glossary:Action}} game developed by [[Company:Chris Pirih|Chris Pirih]] and published by [[Company:Microsoft|Microsoft]].

|release history   = The game was originally sold as part of [[Wikipedia:Microsoft Entertainment Pack|Microsoft Entertainment Pack 3]] for [[Windows|Windows 3.0]] in 1991. A new version of the game updated to run on 32-bit and 64-bit versions of Windows was released for free by the original developer in 2005.
